headline: Greece Hopes Andy Burnham Will Return the Parthenon Sculptures
context: The artworks, also known as the Parthenon marbles, once decorated the renowned ancient temple in Athens, Greece. They have been displayed in the British Museum in London for decades.

sources.name: The New York Times
